meta.question: on Waterbirds K=29, across methods, does the place (background) information a trained student's feature carries inside each class rank the runs inversely to their student WGA?
meta.method: linear probe (class-balanced closed-form ridge, 2-fold CV) on the pre-logit feature, per class; Spearman rank correlation with run bootstrap
meta.paper: Alain & Bengio ICLR-W 2017 (linear probes); Kirichenko et al. ICLR 2023 (DFR, spurious feature decodability); Sagawa et al. ICLR 2020 (Waterbirds groups)
